why: 0.1.443: the owner named the FIELD globe the default cover/closing mark (0.1.442 review, BUG#1 — a deliverable shipped a fresh render instead of the brand), so the field edition is vendored and locked, and the cover pair joins the lock: both had been unlocked since the lock existed, which made 'locked' a word in a README for the two files a deliverable actually embeds. Re-hashed once in the same release: the vendored file's own comments cited the pre-drawer script paths (globe_svg and build_region_palette at the scripts root), which the script-path guard rightly refused; the citations were updated to the current drawers, pixels untouched. 0.1.477: the owner withdrew globe-mark.svg and globe-mark-small.svg as no longer fit for purpose. They are deleted and the generator no longer emits them; the FIELD globe and the cover pair are untouched, which is what this lock exists to protect. The lock is re-stamped rather than bypassed, because a lock that can be edited around protects nothing — the record of what changed and why is the whole mechanism.
